record.dic_text:
0746 'Aryowk {ar-yo:kh'}

源自外來語; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Arioch 7; 7

亞略 = "如獅子的"
1) 古以拉撒國的王, 基大老瑪的盟國之一 (#創 14:9|)
2) 尼布甲尼撒王手下的劊子手長
record.edic_text:
0746 'Aryowk {ar-yoke'}

of foreign origin;; n pr m

AV - Arioch 7; 7

Arioch = "lion-like"
1) the ancient king of Ellasar, ally of Chedorlaomer
2) the chief of the executioners for Nebuchadnezzar
